items.item: A deadband isn't a lossy shortcut — it's a stated promise about exactly how much a value has to move before anyone needs to hear about it again.

items.item: Client/server and PubSub aren't a slow option and a fast one — they're two different places to put the cost of fan-out: in a session per listener, or in a broker that owns it instead.
